_comment: Hand-curated graded prices that override TCGPriceLookup. Use when the upstream source conflates printings (e.g. C1 cards where TCGPriceLookup only indexes 'Normal' but the eBay sales tagged to that record actually reflect Holofoil pricing). The ETL merges these rows AFTER pulling TCGPriceLookup, so override rows always win on PK collision. Each row needs the same fields graded_prices_daily PK uses + the eBay price columns. `date` accepts 'today' as a literal which the ETL resolves at write time. `notes` is freeform and ignored.

overrides.notes: Baymax C1 Holofoil — TCGPriceLookup tags this CGC 8 sale to the Normal record; it's actually the foil. Verify on eBay before trusting.
